newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso gains in sluggish session.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso gains in sluggish session.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 29 Reuter - Colombia's peso gained one peso to close at 1,062.95 against the dollar Tuesday in sluggish markets, interbank traders said.
"There was no real interest from either industry or the banks," one Bogota dealer said. "Most organizations have squared their month-end positions and are not moving."
Dealers reported 293 trades worth a total $123 million, below the daily average of about $180 million. The peso hit an intraday high of 1,062 and sank to a low of 1,064.
